item.title: Police growing increasingly concerned for missing Antrim Man
item.description: Missing Antrim man Mervyn Fletcher Police in Antrim have issued an appeal for information as concern grows for a 69-year-old man who has been reported missing. Mervyn Fletcher was last seen on the Springfarm Road area of Antrim between midday and 2pm on Wednesday 28 January. Officers say efforts to locate him have so far been unsuccessful and they are urging the public to assist. item.description: Rebecca Mackey, Level 3 Agriculture Apprentice pictured on her home farm in Ballynure.
